(f.l.).
concrete, a pleasure, (pl.), (pl.); ἡδοναὶ τραγημάτωνsweetmeats, .
, desires after pleasure, pleasant lusts, , , al.
in Ion. Philosophers, taste, flavour, usu. joined with χροιή, , (pl.), cf. , , , ap. , Mnesith. ap. eund..
